valid_fixes: Set FrontQueue VisibilityTimeout to 120 to match Lambda timeout
Set FrontQueue VisibilityTimeout to any value >= Lambda Timeout (120)
invalid_patches: Reducing Lambda Timeout to match reduced VisibilityTimeout
Adding a DLQ without fixing VisibilityTimeout
optimal_diagnostic_path: Check SQS queue configuration to observe VisibilityTimeout (30) is less than FrontHandlerFunction Timeout (120); restore VisibilityTimeout to 120.
observability_check: Messages are delivered to the front-handler Lambda multiple times; duplicate DynamoDB writes observed under load
observable_symptom: Under load, friend-action messages are processed more than once per message; idempotency guards fire and suppress duplicates, but throughput is degraded and CloudWatch shows multiple concurrent invocations per message ID.
root_cause: SQS VisibilityTimeout (30 s) is shorter than the Lambda function timeout (120 s). Messages become visible again while still being processed, triggering concurrent duplicate invocations.
